about_the_game:
This is a business - simulation game. The in - game graphics present a layout of Chinese - style ancient architecture. Players own a place similar to an inn or a shop. In the scene, there are areas such as the main house and the sales department. The architectural decorations feature traditional Chinese elements, like overhanging eaves and wooden structures. Players can conduct business management within this place.

Game Functions

  • Resource Management: The number of gold coins and diamonds is displayed at the top of the screen. Players can manage these resources for store operations, building upgrades, etc.

  • Building and Area Management: There are different functional building areas such as the "main house" and the "small sales department". Players need to perform operations like construction, upgrading, and furnishing on these areas to enhance the business efficiency and revenue of the place.

  • Quest System: There is also a "Quest" button at the bottom. Players can obtain rewards by completing quests, which advances the game progress.

  • Construction Function: It also includes a construction function. Players can build new buildings or facilities in the scene to expand the business scale.

  • Character Out - of - Area Function: The out - of - area function may allow players to leave the place to explore, trade, and pick up external quests, etc. The "Achievement" button enables players to view the game achievements they have accomplished.
